notes.title: V1.3: Balance updates + SS2 sneak-peek!
notes.content:
V1.3: Balance updates!

TL;DR changes: Weapon rebalances, some QoL stuff


I'd love to hear what you think about the weapon rebalances. As always, please report bugs :)
[url=https://discord.com/invite/2W6mYyG5Va]Join our discord! [/url]

# Patch Notes

## Weapon Changes

### Katana & Poison Katana
- **Katana:** Increased hitbox width ×1.5  
- **Poison Katana:**
  - Increased width (same as normal katana)
  - Poison now damages **twice per second** (was once)
  - **Poison damage per tick:** 4 → 12
  - Poison duration unchanged (**2 seconds**)
  - Hitting an already poisoned enemy **resets** poison duration (Previously: Stacked duration)
  - **Bosses now have 50% poison resistance**

### Dagger
- Decreased width ×0.5, increased length ×3  
- Changed color to **white**  
- Hitbox changed to match shape  
  - **Was:** Circle  
  - **Now:** Capsule  

### Battle Axe
- Increased swing speed by **15%**  
  - **Previously:** 1s per swing  
  - **Now:** 0.85s per swing  

### Decay Sword
- Increased **knockback by 500%** (25 → 150)  

---

## Perk Changes

### **[CHANGED]** Iframe Perk → **"Can't Touch Me"**
- **Unchanged:** Grants **1 second** of iframes when damaged  

---

## Item Changes

### **Venus and Mars**
- Added **planet graphics** (Thanks, [Pixel Planet Generator!](https://deep-fold.itch.io/pixel-planet-generator))  
- Planets now rotate **100% faster**  
- Rotation radius increased **0.8m → 1m**  

### **Coin Mask**
- **Activate:** (unchanged) Pull all coins towards you, dealing damage to enemies  
- Increased damage **15 → 40**  
- **REMOVED:** Dropping a coin when taking damage  
- **NEW:** 
  - Spawns **10 coins** around the player  
- **Rarity:** **Epic → Rare** (should spawn more often)  
- **Recharge cost:** **6 → 3 kills**  

---

## UI Changes

### **Win & Lose Screen**
- Changed **"Times Hit"** → **"Damage Received"** (now correctly tracks hits)  
- Removed **"Damage Dealt"**  
- Added **"Rooms Visited"**  

### **NEW: In-Game Wiki**
- Accessible **after winning once**  
- Displays an overview of **all weapons, perks, and items**  

---

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where the **starter weapon made no attack sounds** unless dropped and picked up again

---

I'm also hard at work at creating Samurai Shampoo 2! Here is a small sneak peak. Be aware, I will probably be changing a lot of the art!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40746720/2d8a5409c086edc762ddffba958f77836b5a33f2.png[/img]

notes.title: Samurai Shampoo V1.2: The weapon update
notes.content:
Hiya folks!

Update V1.2: The weapon update has been released.
Some of the major new features are:
[list]
[*] New weapons!
[*] A weapon selection screen when you start a new run;
[*] Rebalanced existing weapons;
[*] A new room: A weapon chest room, which only drops one or more weapons;
[*] Rebalanced normal chest drops to drop more weapons;
[*] An overhauled UI;
[*] Rebalanced perks;
[*] General polish & bug fixing.
[/list]
The full patchnotes can be found below.
Here's a gif showing off 2 of the new weapons:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1667770/extras/gif6.gif?t=1642199100[/img]

We've also updated the store- and library assets with new art, drawn by [url=https://www.artstation.com/duder]Gleb Poturaev [/url]. Check it out:

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40746720/149ccb27f5e5fc1eb35e767b800a3b221ae6714e.png[/img]

Thanks for everyone, inside the discord and out, for helping playtest this version and give feedback to the changes. We really appreciate it!

We're unsure what way we'll develop towards Samurai Shampoo next. Feel free to send us suggestions :)
The android mobile port of Samurai Shampoo is almost ready for release as well; so stay tuned for that as well!

As always, we welcome any feedback. The best way to give us feedback is to [url=https://discord.com/invite/2W6mYyG5Va]join our discord[/url], but feel free to comment on this news post as well!

Now, for the changelogs:
[list]
[*]UI/Hud/Main Menu[list]
[*]Updated the logo[/*]
[*]Added a 'credits' button[/*]
[*]Generally revamped the aesthetics[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]
The weapon update:

[list]
[*]
Added new weapons:

[list]
[*]
Decay Sword:

[list]
[*]Slows enemies on hit[/*]
[*]Resets duration when enemies are hit a second time[/*]
[*]Price: 250[/*]
[*]Damage: 25[/*]
[*]Attack delay: 0.525s[/*]
[*]Knockback: 25[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Echo blade:

[list]
[*]On attack, creates a second version of the blade, copying all its stats (damage, status effects, stun chance, etc)[/*]
[*]Practically, you spawn 2 blades instead of 1.[/*]
[*]Price: 400[/*]
[*]Damage: 20 (per blade)[/*]
[*]Attack delay: 0.6s[/*]
[*]Knockback: 0[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Kyra's dagger

[list]
[*]A small dagger with a quick attack speed, which provides a buff to movement & attack after 3 consecutive hits.[/*]
[*]Price: 300[/*]
[*]Damage: 10[/*]
[*]Attack delay: 0.2s[/*]
[*]Knockback: 10[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Battle axe:

[list]
[*]A powerful, big, but slow, axe that swipes 360 degrees around the player[/*]
[*]Price: 450[/*]
[*]Damage: 40[/*]
[*]Attack delay: 1.35s[/*]
[*]Knockback: 90[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Added a weapon selection screen

[list]
[*]You no longer start with the Katana. When starting a run, you can choose one of three randomly selected weapons[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Reworked item descriptions to describe the mechanics of the items

[list]
[*]For example, "Heals several hearts" is now written as "Heals for <X> amount of hearts"[/*]
[*]Active items now also describe how they recharge[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Dungeon generation:

[list]
[*]
We've received feedback that players really like receiving weapons, but almost never get them. This usually leads to dissapointment when opening chests. In response to this, we've tweaked the generation a bit.

[/*]
[*]
Added a new treasure room: the Weapon Chest room. 

[list]
[*]Spawns a chest which has a 100% chance to spawn a weapon.[/*]
[*]Can be identified by the red-tinted chest.[/*]
[*]Guaranteed to spawn on the first floor.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Each floor will now have one additional guaranteed player-favored room.

[list]
[*]Previously, each level always had one shop, and one chest room.[/*]
[*]Now, each level has at least one shop, and one chest room, but can also have an additional shop, chest room, or weapon treasure room.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Chest room:

[list]
[*]Tweaked the weighted drop chance of weapons from 0.2, to 0.25[/*]
[*]Chests no longer exclusively drop hearts, but these instead have a chance to be dropped as bonus items.[list]
[*]This change also considerably increases the chances of weapon drops.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Shops:

[list]
[*]Will now have a 4th item on sale on the third floor.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Item rebalances:

[list]
[*]
We wanted to make all swords viable, instead of having one sword be the best. We've rebalanced the weapons to reflect this.

[/*]
[*]
Katana:

[list]
[*]Damage 20 -> 25[/*]
[*]Attack delay: 0.4 -> 0.35[/*]
[*]We wanted the katana to be a neutral, jack-of-all-traits sword, so we changed the stats to reflect this.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Broadsword

[list]
[*]Knockback: 60 -> 50[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Poison Katana

[list]
[*]Poison stacking: No longer stacks damage, but stacks duration[/*]
[*]We noticed poison was too powerful when used on bosses (Especially the bullet hell boss). To make it less powerful on bosses, the attack damage no longer stacks when you apply poison on one enemy, multiple times. However, the duration of the poison now stacks. This rework changes the strategy of the sword from "hit the boss 20 times and run" to a viable helper during normal battle.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Nothing Personell Kid (Dash sword)

[list]
[*]Damage: 20 -> 25[/*]
[*]Attack Delay: 0.6s -> 0.5s[/*]
[*]The dash sword felt like it had too much risk, without having enough reward. By upping the damage, we up the reward.
By decreasing the attack delay, we encourage the player to keep dash-chaining.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Kira's Dagger's buffs now last for 0.7s.

[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Status effects:

[list]
[*]Slowdown color is now blue instead of grey.[/*]
[*]Stun color is now yellow instead of grey.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]
Perks:

[list]
[*]
Stun perk now has a cooldown when used on bosses.

[list]
[*]We noticed a combination of the stun perk + faster attacking perk, stunlocks bosses. We want to prevent this, so we added a cooldown.[/*]
[*]Added a visual effect when you stun an enemy[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
The three planet perks

[list]
[*]Removed the three individual planet perks.[/*]
[*]Added a new perk which grants the player two planets at once, Venus and Mars.[/*]
[*]We heard feedback that the individual planet perks were too underpoweded and showed up in the perk selection screen too much.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]
Chest drop perks

[list]
[*]Removed the "More minimum drops from chests" and the "More maximum drops from chests" perks.[/*]
[*]Added the "Treasure Hunter" perk which combines the two higher drop perks, giving the player 1 more minimum drop, and 2 more maximum drops per chest.[/*]
[*]
We received feedback that the more-drops-from-chests perks were too underpowered. We hope that the new combined perk provides a more viable perk, whilst also having a nice synergy with the newly added chest-drop rebalances from V1.2E1.

[/*]
[*]
Removed the "More weapons from treasure chests"

[list]
[*]This perk acted as a band-aid solution to the low weapon drops from chests. Due to the chest changes in V1.2E1 (overall more drop chance for weapons + 1 guaranteed weapon chest per level), this perk is now no longer needed nor viable.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Changed the "longer Invulerability frames when damaged" from 0.75 seconds, to 1 second.

[list]
[*]The perk didn't provide the value we wanted. This perk will require some playtesting to get right; We don't want it to be too OP, nor too under powere[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]
Mobs:

[list]
[*]
Added a spawn effect to all bosses

[list]
[*]All bosses now have a small effect before they spawn in, warning users of the incoming boss.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Ogre boss

[list]
[*]Dash force: 1000 -> 950[/*]
[*]Final Phase attack cooldown: 1.4s -> 1.3s[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]
Jumping Green Goblin

[list]
[*]Changed stomp attack collision from a box based collision, to a circle based collision.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]General polish:    [list]
[*]Updated the tab menu's aesthetics[list]
[*]We have received feedback that the tab menu's original colors were very bright and cause eye strain, because the tab menu fills the entire screen.[/*]
[*]In response, we've changed the tab menu to be grey-ish colors and mostly transparant. This also helps if a player wants to move through rooms whilst opening the tab menu.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Updated the text of pop-up prompts[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Fixes:[list]
[*]Fixed items staying on the ground throughout runs if they were switched out of a player's inventory at some point[/*]
[*]Fixed some spelling mistakes in item/weapon/perk descriptions[/*]
[*]The tab menu can no longer be triggered on the main menu[/*]
[*]Pressing the escape key, now also closes the settings menu as well as the pause menu.[/*]
[*]Corpses who's entities had either the slowdown or the stun effect, are no longer black.[/*]
[*]Knockback can no longer push players/enemies into walls.[/*]
[*]Kira's dagger's effects no longer last indefinetly.  [/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

Thanks for joining us on this journey!

Kind regards,
Joey and Luke.

notes.title: Playtesters needed to test the new update!
notes.content:
Hey there folks!

We're nearing the release of V1.2. To make sure we're all set, we really want to playtest the heck out of it!

So far, the new update has:
[list]
[*] New weapons
[*] Rebalanced weapons
[*] The ability to pick your starter weapon
[*] Rebalanced items and perks
[*] Rebalanced chest drop rates and added a new type of chest: The weapon chest.
[*] And other things which are too much to write out here!
[/list]
We're currently on version 1.2E3 (The E means it's a beta build!). More detailed patchnotes can be found on [url=https://discord.com/invite/2W6mYyG5Va]our discord[/url].

"Well, how do I help?" Great question, Voice-in-my-head #5! We've currently releasing the beta on a branch inside of Steam. It might sound complicated, but it isn't! All you have to know, is that by selecting a different 'branch' of the game in Steam, you switch to the new version.

In order to switch branch:
[list]
[*] Go to steam
[*] Right click on Samurai Shampoo in your library
[*] Click on Properties
[*] Click on ``betas``
[*] Select the "updatetestbranch"
[*] If Steam asks for an access code, leave it blank and press ok.
[/list]

If you ever want to switch back to the 'current' Samurai Shampoo, switch to the 'default' branch instead of the 'updatetestbranch'.

The best way to give us feedback, report bugs, or discuss the update with other fans, you can join [url=https://discord.com/invite/2W6mYyG5Va]our discord[/url]. Alternatively, feel free to make a thread in the Steam Forums :)

We're excited to see what you think! 

Cheers,
Joey and Luke.

PS. Here's a picture of the new weapon selection screen:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40746720/539ec962cc9cceb8e4f559f2e9b46003d7b474cb.png[/img]

notes.title: Help us balance the game | Player satisfaction survey
notes.content:
Hey there folks!

We're hard at work on the 1.2 update. We want you to help us balance this patch!
Do you think some items should be buffed? Some weapons nerfed? Or both?
You can give your opinions on items, perks, etc by filling in the survey below.
The survey takes about 5 to 10 minutes to complete:

The survey: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfFIGhjQkvDFrkg6gC-WglQ0z-Yc8z7FITaHB0pqxOamBsuGQ/viewform?usp=sf_link

We're going to keep your opinions in mind when rebalancing weapons, items, and perks. We're also curious about what you'd like to see for the next update!
We'd really appreciate it if you'd fill in the survey. 

Thanks!
Joey and the Samurai Shampoo Team.
P.S. Have you joined our discord yet? https://discord.com/invite/2W6mYyG5Va
P.P.S Here's a sneak peak of the new main menu (and logo!) in version 1.2:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9hAOGe9.png[/img]

notes.title: V1.1.6 released: Ogre boss fix, achievements
notes.content:
V1.1.6 changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed the hard-lock bug where defeating the Ogre boss wouldn't allow you to progress the game
[*] Added 6 achievements; 3 of which are 'hidden'
[/list]

This will probably be the last update before Steam reviews the game so they don't have to keep testing the new build in the middle of testing the previous one.
